description: FhirWriteCompletedData: see $defs/FhirWriteCompletedData. Internal only: CareFlow wrote a confirmed triage to the hospital FHIR server. It travels on the CareFlow event bus (for the audit log, M5-01) and is never a webhook or a WebSocket message. No name, date of birth or free text.

FhirWriteCompletedData.title: FhirWriteCompletedData
FhirWriteCompletedData.description: Internal only: CareFlow wrote a confirmed triage to the hospital FHIR server as one transaction Bundle (M1-09). No name, date of birth or free text.

bundle_id.description: The transaction Bundle's identifier (a UUID derived from the session and the nurse decision, the same on every retry).

resource_count.description: Resources in the Bundle, created or already present.
